_about: Railway gauge (release 2, batch 3; Brian's yes of 27 November 2026 17:10Z; the design director's rulings of 17:15Z and 17:48Z on r2-three-ideas/FORM-rails-rivers-1127.md, part A). Behind the grand campaign's flag 'gauge', OFF until its gate. 'home' is each nation's own gauge, by the nation; every nation not listed runs on the standard gauge. A province's track at the war's opening is the gauge of its owner that day (the region's owner), until a nation's railway troops re-lay it to their own; then the province's flag 'ga:<id>' holds the new gauge, and whoever takes it next finds that gauge. 'relay' is how many provinces of captured track a nation's railway troops re-lay a month: a capacity, the same for every nation. A nation's trains run only on track of its own gauge.
